title: Dumb Totem
description: A frustratingly simple mod that prevents you from holding a Totem of Undying in your offhand by kicking it back into your inventory or dropping it.
body:
# Dumb Totem

### Because who needs immortality anyway?

Ever felt like Totems of Undying are just a bit too helpful?
Do you miss the sweet, unforgiving embrace of death in Minecraft?

**Good news:** this mod fixes that “problem”.

Dumb Totem makes sure you can no longer cheese your way through danger by casually holding a totem in your offhand.
Whether you want a real challenge or just want to troll your friends — this mod delivers.

## 💀 What does it do?

It adds one simple rule to the game:

**You. Shall. Not. Hold. Totems. In. Your. Offhand.**

## ❌ The Rejection

Try putting a Totem of Undying in your offhand?

The mod politely waits 3 ticks
Then immediately yeets it back into your inventory

No warnings. 
No mercy.

## 📦 The “Full Inventory” Fallback

Inventory full? No space left?

Perfect.

The totem drops on the ground at your feet
Hope you notice it before something else does 🙂
## 🔒 Anti-Dupe Protection

No funny business here:

Carefully timed 3-tick delay
Synchronized slot handling
No ghost items, no duplication exploits

Just pure, honest suffering.

## ✨ Features
- 100% Annoyance Guaranteed™
- Removes the “easy mode” safety net
- Smart Inventory Handling
- Finds the first available slot automatically
- Server-Friendly
- Works client-side, feels like a universal law
## ⚙️ Technical Details
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Dependencies:** Fabric API
## 🧠 Why?

- Because consequences are fun.
- Because danger should be dangerous.
- Because someone had to do it.
